title: Is it necessary to service my AC every few months?
desc: Yes, in the Dubai climate, servicing every 3 to 6 months helps stop big problems and keeps your cooling bills manageable.

title: Why is my AC leaking water?
desc:
Several common issues can lead to water leakage.
  • Drain pipe blockage
  • Frozen or dirty coils
  • Poor water flow

title: Does your cleaning service get rid of smells?
desc: Yes, our cleaning process removes mold and bacteria that cause smells. We get rid of mold and bacteria buildup to remove smells.

title: Can I get a repair done on the day?
desc: We try to fix issues on the same day. Call us early so we can check if our technicians are available in Marina.

title: How long does a standard maintenance visit take?
desc: Most visits take an hour. It depends on how many units you have and their condition.

title: Do you work with all AC brands?
desc: Yes, we work with brands like Daikin, LG, Samsung and many more.

title: Is an AMC really worth the cost?
desc: Yes, it saves your money. You won't have to pay for an emergency fix. Your equipment will last longer.

title: Why is my AC making noise?
desc:
There are a few reasons.
  • Loose parts inside the unit
  • Fan or motor issue
  • Dirt inside the system

title: How do I know if I need a repair or a simple cleaning?
desc: If your AC is weak, try cleaning. If it's leaking, making noise or not cooling it needs a repair.

title: Do you provide services for offices?
